# gezor_aws_lake (Resource)

The workspace's data lake buckets in your AWS account. Needs a validated `gezor_aws_connection`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gezor_aws_lake" "this" {
  bronze_uri = "s3://acme-lake-bronze"
  silver_uri = "s3://acme-lake-silver"
  gold_uri   = "s3://acme-lake-gold"
  prefix     = "gzr/"

  depends_on = [gezor_aws_connection.this]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bronze_uri` (String) `s3://` URI for raw data.
- `gold_uri` (String) `s3://` URI for curated data.
- `silver_uri` (String) `s3://` URI for cleaned data.

### Optional

- `kms_key_arn` (String) AWS KMS key used for the buckets.
- `prefix` (String) Object key prefix inside each bucket.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace id or slug. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`. Changing it recreates the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `lake`.
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax. Append `@<workspace>` to import from a workspace other than the provider default.

```shell
terraform import gezor_aws_lake.example lake
```
